name: mixed_dtypes_linear
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_mixed_dtypes_linear(Tensor input, Tensor weight, Tensor scale, *, Tensor? bias=None, str? activation=None) -> Tensor. Computes a floating-point linear layer from uint8 weights interpreted as int8 or packed int4 values, with per-output scales and optional bias and activation. Tests cover both packing modes, relu/silu/no activation, batched inputs, output metadata, non-mutation, and invalid contracts.
